summary: Implemented the rotate command (--dry-run, --force, stream arguments) per docs/rotate.md in logkeep/rotate.py, with a strict policy.ini loader (logkeep/policy.py), time parsing in dates.py and CLI wiring in cli.py. Existing unit tests pass, and I tried it on a copy of /app/data; where the docs were ambiguous I made judgement calls, such as rejecting negative or non-integer rotations in state.json.
